The reply says the sources conflict and calls dexoraline "the more widely reported answer," but it adds "I can't confirm it" and gives a stated confidence of only 35. It leans toward A without committing to it. Because it declines to settle on an answer, I label it undetermined.

Still, "more widely reported" does suggest a preference. The explicit refusal to confirm, together with the low confidence, makes it read as uncommitted.

N
